title: Code for "Collision avoidance with a moving obstacle: Anticipation without prediction"
description: Analysis and modeling code for the article "Collision avoidance with a moving obstacle: Anticipation without prediction" (Bai, Cohen, Bruggeman & Warren), submitted to the Journal of Experimental Psychology: General. It fits and simulates behavioral-dynamics models of pedestrian collision avoidance with a moving obstacle (an omniscient and a visual avoidance model combined with a goal model) and analyzes the human walking trajectories. The data are archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24547578.
